name: Beef Cheeseburger with Tomato, Shallot, Pickles & Sweet Potato Fries (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional).

When the oven is heated, transfer fries to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy, about 25 minutes. (Or cook according to package instructions.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (567 g) bag julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place beef and spices in a medium bowl, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 3 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g lean ground beef
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, medium dice half of the cheese, place on a clean plate for the kids, and set aside. Coarsely grate remaining cheese.
Peel and slice shallot crosswise into thin rings.

When the patties are done on one side, flip, then top 2 with the grated cheese and shallot (leave one patty plain for the kid plates). Continue to grill until patties are cooked through, 5-7 minutes more. Transfer to another plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.

While the burgers are cooking, wash and dry tomatoes. Halve one tomato lengthwise, cut into ½-inch thick wedges, and add to the plate with the diced cheese. Slice remaining tomato crosswise into thin rounds and set aside.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Cut the plain burger patty into bite-sized pieces. Divide between plates along with 1 cup of sweet potato fries, diced cheese, and tomato wedges. Serve with ketchup and mayo as desired. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Spread mayo and ketchup (as desired) on the bottom half of each bun, then top with cheesy patties, tomato slices, and pickles. Serve with remaining sweet potato fries and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp ketchup
3 tbsp mayonnaise
4 slice dill pickle sandwich slices
